body: WIVB reported that a state supreme court judge on Thursday approved the Town of Amherst's bid to acquire properties on the Boulevard Mall site through eminent domain. The report, carried by Yahoo News, does not name the judge, identify the owners of the properties or give any compensation amount.
The town supervisor told the station, "we are now very close to beginning the demolition process." He said more details on the judgment will be available during a town board meeting on Nov. 30.

timeline.label: State supreme court judge approves the Town of Amherst's eminent domain bid for properties on the Boulevard Mall site
Town board meeting at which the town says more details on the judgment will be available (scheduled)
